content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-383. - False reporting.
content.summary:

             …

faqs.a:
Any person who intentionally, knowingly or recklessly gives false or misleading information
               or who makes any false statement concerning any allegation of a violation of this
               Code or in the course of an investigation of any allegation of a violation of this
               Code shall be subject to prosecution pursuant to
section 62-58
.
(Code 1981, § 2-63; Ord. No. 3088, § 2, 6-27-1994)
